extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and patent examiners
extracted.subtask_description: MPEP Chapter 0200 table of contents covering types and status of patent applications and rules for claiming benefit/priority (including provisional, nonprovisional, continuation, divisional, foreign priority, certified copies, and related timing and formal requirements). Useful for practitioners preparing or evaluating benefit/priority claims and application status issues.
